screens.name: Home, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows the dominant orb, touch instruction and unavailable omen; supplied motion evidence supports browser continuity only; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Give the unavailable omen a clearer recovery path and keep the small example question consistently readable against the mist.

screens.name: Ask, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 presents a labeled question field, typing/voice alternatives and a prominent submit button with closely matching transition composition; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Increase the small field label and disclosure text so their readability better matches the question and primary action.

screens.name: Ask at 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the enlarged question, disclosure, voice alternative and complete submit button, while supplied browser evidence reports enlarged-form traversal; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Validate this readable enlarged layout with native text scaling and an actual phone keyboard before certifying accessibility.

screens.name: Approach loading, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 pairs the large orb with 'Opening your question,' and supplied evidence specifies automatic advancement after 650ms or immediately with reduced motion; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify that the brief automatic handoff preserves understandable focus and announcements on physical assistive technology.

screens.name: Listening unavailable, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows a dominant typing fallback, secondary voice retry and explanatory notice, with transcription preservation reported in the supplied evidence; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Place the microphone failure explanation closer to the fallback actions so users need not connect widely separated regions.

screens.name: Planning loading, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 identifies the planning stage, expected wait, credit protection and Cancel action, with browser motion and reduced-motion behavior reported; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Increase the readability of the small wait-and-credit reassurance and verify loading announcements on a screen reader.

screens.name: Question card 1, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows a clear question, four spacious answers and '1 of 3,' while supplied keyboard evidence reports activation, focus transfer and restored answers; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Verify that immediate advancement and Back restoration remain understandable with VoiceOver and TalkBack.

screens.name: Question card 2, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 preserves the question-and-answer arrangement with '2 of 3' and stable transition placement, supported by the supplied keyboard checks; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Confirm spoken question context arrives before the first answer receives user navigation after immediate advancement.

screens.name: Question card 3, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the final progress step and consistent answer rows, with supplied browser evidence covering the follow-up flow; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Make the final answer's transition into prediction generation clear to assistive-technology users.

screens.name: Answer question with keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 visibly outlines the new question heading, and supplied keyboard checks report that Tab subsequently reaches its first answer; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Give the heading focus outline enough breathing room to avoid the cramped, doubled-edge appearance around the text.

screens.name: Custom answer empty, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows the retained question, 'Your answer,' Change, an empty multiline input and a visibly muted Continue button; provisional A=8.0, F=7.3, overall=7.6.
findings: Make the empty-input requirement explicit and improve the disabled button label's legibility without making it look enabled.

screens.name: Custom answer empty at 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 retains the complete enlarged question and form controls without the decorative orb, while browser checks report enlarged-form support; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Preserve this content-first arrangement on physical devices and clarify why Continue is unavailable before text entry.

screens.name: Custom answer filled at 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows the question, entered answer, Change and a complete two-line reveal button, with text retention reported by the supplied form checks; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Verify long-answer editing and caret visibility on a physical keyboard-constrained viewport.

screens.name: Custom answer with synthetic keyboard constraint
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows the input and complete reveal button but no question in the visible constrained region, while supplied checks report retained context in a synthetic 390×500 viewport; provisional A=7.7, F=7.3, overall=7.5.
findings: Demonstrate an easy way to revisit the question while editing and submitting with an actual phone keyboard open.

screens.name: Research loading, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 distinguishes research from planning through its supporting text and retains the wait estimate, credit reassurance and cancellation; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Strengthen the small stage-description text so the progression from planning to research is easier to notice.

screens.name: Reveal, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a readable settled prediction and a dimmer entrance frame, with Why, check-back date, sharing and follow-up actions supported by the reported browser drive; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Keep prediction text readable throughout its entrance and clarify the relative priority of sharing, reminders and revising the reading.

screens.name: Reveal with Why expanded, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows the expanded explanation beneath an unchanged large hero region, pushing remaining content beyond the captured viewport; provisional A=7.7, F=7.7, overall=7.7.
findings: Reduce the hero's footprint when Why expands so more explanation and subsequent actions can be reached with less scrolling.

screens.name: Check-in, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 place three outcome choices below the prediction and above sharing, with the supplied browser drive reporting real outcome persistence; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Increase the prominence of the outcome prompt so checking in feels like the main task rather than an accessory to sharing.

screens.name: Outcome Yes saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows checked Yes, inline 'Saved · Came true' and a notice, with supplied checks reporting live status and persistence after reload; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Use the persistent inline confirmation as the main feedback and reduce the large notice's competition with lower-page actions.

screens.name: Outcome Not quite saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 pairs selected 'Not quite' with 'Saved · Didn’t come true,' and supplied checks report actual storage persistence; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Align the saved status with 'Not quite' because that choice can imply partial success rather than complete failure.

screens.name: Outcome Not yet saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows checked Not yet, matching inline saved status and 'Still waiting to unfold,' with persistence reported in the supplied evidence; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Verify that assistive technology announces the saved pending status once without duplicate notice interruptions.

screens.name: Planning error, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 visibly separates the failure headline, no-charge reassurance, Try again and Edit question, with fixture labeling explicitly supplied; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify error announcement and focus placement on physical assistive technology while retaining the clear retry/edit hierarchy.

screens.name: Prediction error, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to retry and question editing, and supplied runtime evidence reports connection recovery; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Confirm that retry and review preserve every entered answer across physical-device interruption and reconnection.

screens.name: Sensitive planning redirect, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 presents support, a stronger ask-something-else button and no-credit/no-memory reassurance, with a real sensitive redirect reported in the browser drive; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Give the support action stronger visual priority when the message says support is the appropriate next step.

screens.name: Sensitive prediction redirect, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 preserves the same support and recovery choices after the prediction stage, with stable transition composition; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Prioritize the support route over restarting the entertainment flow and verify that its destination is usable on the target device.

screens.name: History empty, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 explains the empty state with a direct Ask the Ball action and a local-storage disclosure; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Make the empty-state action's tappable area and focus treatment as dependable as the app's primary buttons.

screens.name: History populated, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 separates date, original question, prediction and check-back date, while supplied runtime evidence reports history persistence; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Use a friendlier check-back date and make the row's openable behavior apparent without relying on discovery.

screens.name: History stress list
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows multiple consistently structured entries continuing toward the fixed tab bar, with scrolling reachability not independently observed; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify the final row and its complete metadata can scroll clear of the fixed tab bar at normal and enlarged text sizes.

screens.name: History with persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 replaces the first entry's check-back label with checked 'Came true,' and supplied evidence identifies real save controls and storage behind the synthetic reading; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Keep outcome labels consistent between the reading screen and history for every saved choice.

screens.name: Sky offline sample, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 clearly labels sample stars and selected Love, but the visible 'Ask this too' button is partially cut off above the navigation region in both captures; provisional A=8.0, F=7.3, overall=7.6.

screens.name: Circles offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 discloses the offline state, offers Retry and mutes circle creation, while supplied controls evidence confirms creation is disabled; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Associate the unavailable creation and sharing controls more directly with the offline explanation.

screens.name: Plans, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 clearly labels simulated billing and selected yearly pricing, but the settled capture clips the decorative orb at the top and distributes options below the fold; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Use a stable compact plans header so the viewport does not begin with a cropped orb and pricing comparison receives more space.

screens.name: Plans at 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 stacks enlarged pricing, billing cadence and the complete simulated continuation button, with browser enlargement checks reported; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.

screens.name: You empty memory and settings, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 14 and 16 show plan status, an explanatory memory empty state and labeled preferences, with activation and persistence covered by supplied controls checks; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.

screens.name: Settings with visible keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 outlines the entire Large text row, and supplied checks report 342×52px preference targets with label, Space and Enter activation; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.

screens.name: Settings at 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 enlarges preference labels and secondary destinations while the bottom navigation labels remain visibly small; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Provide a readable enlarged-text treatment for bottom navigation labels as well as the settings content.

screens.name: You with real populated memory
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows three distinct facts with Edit and Forget actions, and supplied runtime evidence reports an actual Ollama flow plus edit/forget/Undo checks; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Ensure repeated Edit and Forget controls announce their associated fact so they remain distinguishable outside visual context.

screens.name: Share, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show a story preview and labeled output choices, while runtime evidence establishes PNG export but leaves OS delivery and social backend behavior unverified; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Expose availability and recovery per sharing destination, especially the friend-link route when its backend is unavailable.

screens.name: Story export, including transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show the composed story and export button, while supplied evidence reports a real 1080×1920 PNG and injected export-error recovery; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify exported disclaimer readability at actual social viewing sizes and distinguish file creation from successful OS delivery.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The orb anchors the supplied screens consistently, with browser motion checks reported but native interaction unverified; provisional A=9.0, F=7.7, overall=8.2.
findings: Keep its tappable role clear on Home and prevent decorative versions from consuming space needed by long-form content.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: The five labeled destinations use icon, color and underline selection cues, but labels remain small in the enlarged settings capture; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Scale navigation labels appropriately and reserve enough content clearance for the raised central orb and fixed bar.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Sheets show a restrained brand/title treatment and changing daily balance, with no-charge behavior described in supplied runtime evidence; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Clarify the balance's reset timing where users need it and preserve readable sizing across text settings.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream-filled buttons consistently dominate their action groups, with enlarged wrapping and browser activation demonstrated in the supplied material; provisional A=8.7, F=8.0, overall=8.3.
findings: Preserve full button visibility in Sky and verify pressed and focused states across every primary-action placement.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text and quiet action rows recur across retry, editing, reminders and sharing, but universal target and pressed-state coverage is not supplied; provisional A=7.7, F=7.3, overall=7.5.
findings: Standardize generous hit areas and visible focus/press feedback for every text-only action.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show spacious divider-separated rows, and supplied checks cover immediate Space/Enter advancement, focus transfer and Back restoration; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Verify immediate selection feedback and restored answer announcements with physical assistive technology.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheet 02 clearly distinguishes editable content but combines an enclosing gold border with a second inset bottom rule; provisional A=7.7, F=7.7, overall=7.7.
findings: Use one clear field boundary and strengthen the small label and accompanying disclosure.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Sheets 01, 04 and 05 show enlarged multiline text and complete submission controls, supported by synthetic constrained-viewport checks; provisional A=7.7, F=8.0, overall=7.9.
findings: Simplify the doubled field edge and verify caret scrolling, question access and submission with a real phone keyboard.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 14 shows knob-position and color state cues plus full-row focus, with supplied checks reporting 342×52px targets and persisted keyboard activation; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Verify native switch semantics and state announcements while retaining full-row activation.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 08 presents only an unavailable daily omen with 'Try again tomorrow,' leaving successful content and immediate recovery unshown; provisional A=8.0, F=6.7, overall=7.2.
findings: Explain whether the failure is temporary and offer retry when recovery is possible before tomorrow.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 15 uses a checkmark plus color for Love and displays its question, but the associated action is partly clipped and star target measurements are absent; provisional A=8.0, F=7.3, overall=7.6.
findings: Keep the complete selected-question action above navigation and verify generous hit areas around every star-label pair.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 combines privacy scope, offline explanation, Retry and disabled creation, with no configured social backend available for validation; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Make the reason for each disabled control locally apparent and test the populated/invitation states when the backend is available.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheet 07 consistently separates question, prediction, date and saved outcome, with real persistence reported for the synthetic outcome fixture; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Use readable local date formatting and verify each row exposes a concise, meaningful accessible name.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 10 shows checkmarked yearly selection, billing cadence and stacked enlarged pricing, while purchase/restore evidence is explicitly simulated; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Verify selection semantics and actual billing confirmation independently before treating the simulated purchase path as production-ready.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 14–16 show a coherent portrait artifact with very small disclaimer and brand text in the compact preview, and actual PNG generation is reported; provisional A=8.0, F=7.5, overall=7.7.
findings: Increase the exported disclaimer's practical reading size and provide an accessible textual equivalent to the preview.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show clear dismissible notices and inline saved status, with live-status updates and injected export recovery reported but physical announcement behavior unverified; provisional A=7.7, F=7.7, overall=7.7.
findings: Reduce oversized bottom notices and confirm they neither cover essential actions nor duplicate screen-reader announcements.

components.name: Typography
components.evidence: Across the sheets, expressive serif headings and restrained sans-serif controls form consistent roles, while small utility text and tab labels remain comparatively weak; provisional A=8.3, F=7.5, overall=7.8.
findings: Raise the minimum readable utility-text size and validate contrast over the brightest animated background frames.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: The dark mist and warm lower glow remain coherent across screens, with supplied browser evidence reporting sustained frame performance and stopped draws under reduced motion; provisional A=8.5, F=8.0, overall=8.2.
findings: Validate contrast and motion comfort on physical displays while preserving the subdued treatment behind utility content.

limitations: All grades are provisional evaluations of the attached sheets and supplied runtime summary; no files, live app, source, prior ratings or other rounds were inspected.
Transition pairs support composition comparison, while timing, frame continuity and reduced-motion behavior rely on the supplied browser evidence.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware, haptics and OS share delivery remain unverified; no 9/10 overall certification is awarded.
A high individual aesthetic dimension is a visual judgment, not certification of premium functional or accessibility outcomes.
The 144 layout checks, 85 tests, axe results and runtime checks were reported by the supplied evidence and were not independently rerun.
Synthetic predictions and explicitly labeled fixture wording establish layout coverage only, not production-copy defects, predictive accuracy or semantic quality.
Payments are simulated, and configured social/Auth behavior is unavailable; successful purchases, invitations and private-link delivery cannot be inferred.
The partially clipped Sky action and constrained custom-answer context warrant follow-up, but screenshots alone do not establish unreachable controls or a hard-gate failure.
No modal state was distinctly represented, so modal-specific behavior cannot be graded.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met; averages do not remove the documented component and evidence gaps.
topFixes: Keep Sky's entire 'Ask this too' button above the fixed navigation and raised Ask orb.
Improve small utility text, navigation labels and low-emphasis text readability, including enlarged-text layouts.
Match the saved 'Not quite' status to the selected wording instead of converting it to categorical failure.
Reduce hero space in expanded explanations and stabilize the plans header to avoid visibly cropped decoration.
Clarify unavailable omen, circle and sharing recovery paths without implying unverified backend capability.
Complete physical-phone, keyboard and assistive-technology checks before any 9/10 certification.
